name: Awano (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Awano town emblem in white: a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised mountain of angled strokes.
history: Flag of the former town of Awano in Tochigi Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-01-01.

features.role: Awano town emblem — a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised mountain of angled strokes
